name: H5N1 bird flu
value: Dairy-linked US cases; no human spread
summary: US H5N1 cases remain dairy-linked; Oregon found its first infected herd on 12 Nov; no human spread
state: ECDC's 3 Nov update records two more H5N1 cases in Yakima County, Washington, one fatal, bringing the county to three, linked to dairy cattle (ECDC). Oregon confirmed its first H5N1 case in a dairy herd on 12 Nov, in Morrow County (OPB). Cases remain sporadic animal-to-human, with no human-to-human spread or cluster under investigation, so the level stays Normal; the trend is rising.
for_you: Follow UKHSA and CDC advice: avoid contact with sick or dead birds and animals, and do not drink raw milk.

why: H5N1 is the flu strain scientists most fear could become a pandemic; it has spread to mammals and dairy cattle.
